name: Inline save status
summary: A small line of text next to a form or editor that says whether changes are saving, saved, failed or waiting for the network.
description: Use it for autosave, where there is no Save button to confirm the action. Vectra.saveStatus() sets the state and the words; the CSS draws the icon.

classes.name: v-save-status
classes.description: The status line, with an icon drawn for each data-state.

states.description: A green check; the text says how long ago.

api.description: Sets data-state and the text. Saved shows the time since at (default now) and refreshes it every 30 seconds. Writes into the child marked data-v-save-status-text if there is one, otherwise into el itself.

a11y: saveStatus() announces Saved and failed messages politely by itself; keep the element out of live regions so the 30-second refreshes stay quiet.
Saving and offline are not announced, so a busy editor does not chatter.
The icon is decoration; the words carry the state.

hooks.name: data-v-save-status-text
hooks.description: The element whose text saveStatus() replaces; without it the whole status element's text is replaced.
